subject: a_c_spear_q519_24bit_is_mac_not_identity
body:
A-C-10-7-5-01 SPEAR 24-bit MAC product != identity (not a rematch of 082907/083853)

FACT: live R1 §10.7.5 SHA 0639de2f: Q1.7 x Q4.12 -> Q5.19 in 24 bits, then 32-bit acc.
Architecture (A-owned; Qm.n remains C CANDIDATE; A does not freeze the format):
  SPEAR_MAC_PRODUCT_WIDTH != SEMANTIC_ID_WIDTH
  That 24 is ranking arithmetic, not a 24-bit semantic-ID law
  It is also not ACTIVE_ID_RANGE (profile legal-ID subset)

Keep live §10.7.5 wording. Do not retitle the product width as identity.
NOT RTL_PASS. NOT a 24-bit ID type.
